goal: freeze a single canonical build as the Release Candidate only after all Phase 11 release gates are certified
freeze_contract: each completion artifact must report status=pass and the correct roadmap_step
each certified commit must exist in full git history and be an ancestor of the candidate HEAD
11.8 zero blocker/critical gate must still pass
launch localization pack, terminology and linguistic gates must pass
11.1 regression matrix must pass on the candidate HEAD
11.6 overflow and iconography gates must pass on the candidate HEAD
11.7 audiovisual context must pass on the candidate HEAD
11.9 reliability soak must pass on the candidate HEAD
the workflow must finish with no repository diff
note: This infrastructure is intentionally fail-closed. Preparing 11.10 does not promote the roadmap step before its prerequisites and same-HEAD runtime gates are green.
